appearance: User-requested approximate placement: all coating layers and source-limb sparks share a screen drop equal to 10% of the compact outer-smoke base height. Outer smoke scale is .17, giving a 1.088*tileScale pixel drop (2.176 pixels at B42 tile scale 2). Base core scale .22, middle Gaiden wisp .065, outer smoke .17 and small limb sparks .065 reduce the previous outer diameter by about 35% and core by about 21%. Original Gaiden, Kiwami 2 and Yakuza 6 pixels remain unchanged; layered translucency, colours, swirls and budgets are retained.
tracking: Removed the 0.123.0 56-pixel screen shift after the user observed arm smoke at foot level. The isolated character-camera reconstruction did not establish end-to-end effect placement and its alignment conclusion is withdrawn. Runtime returns to the native bone/world projection and applies only the requested small cosmetic drop, preserving world coordinates/depth. The same small drop is captured for limb-origin flying sparks and used for charging effects. Native source-bone Heat Action/blood anchors receive no added camera shift. Active leg effects retain proportional track weights instead of the former 70-percent cutoff. Baked pose curves and the actual final blended/rendered skeleton can still differ; live in-game placement has not been verified.

modelProjection.status: The 0.123 camera-only alignment inference was contradicted by user-observed placement and withdrawn.
modelProjection.currentMethod: Actual installed Model.vectorToWorldCoords and IsoUtils.XToScreen/YToScreen, with no synthetic camera translation.
modelProjection.scope: Checks bone/world coordinate math and handedness. This does not validate the final engine-blended skeleton or end-to-end in-game placement.
modelProjection.dropBasis: 64-pixel outer smoke frame times its .17 base scale times tileScale
